text:
Maya: Dashboard alert this morning at ~09:40UTC  seeing small customers suddenly create hundreds of new route keys. Looks like attribution blowup.
Rohit: Any obvious client change?
Maya: Found a sample header from a broken client: `x-rd-route: eyJyZWFsbV9pZCI6IjEyMzQiLCJ2ZXIiOjF9` (base64 JSON). Our routing infra expects plain `realid:1234` ascii token.
Sam: Interesting. Which SDKs emitted that?
Maya: Traced back to a TS rollout two days ago (2.1.0-beta). Python lib started wrapping for a short-lived experiment too (py 1.5.0-beta). Go unaffected.
Nina: If router decodes base64 -> JSON, the key becomes new and never matches legacy route buckets. Console shows new tiny shards per-customer.
Rohit: Short-term: can we make the router permissive for now and normalize to canonical `realid:...` before attribution?
Maya: I pushed a patch on the edge proxy to try parsing in this order: 1) ascii-prefixed, 2) base64-decoded then JSON->prefixed, 3) legacy fallback. Mapped results get normalized to canonical for metrics. Deployed to canary group.
Sam: Please annotate telemetry so we can see how much of traffic hits the second branch. Add metric `route.header.parse_strategy` with tag values `ascii|b64-json|legacy`.
Maya: Done. Also added an `X-Rd-Parse` response header in canary: `X-Rd-Parse: b64-json->realid:1234` so SDKs can surface debug logs if users enable verbose client logging.
Rohit: For SDK fixes: plan is to revert the experiment in TS and Python to emit canonical ascii. We should release patches that are non-breaking but warn on the old format. Sam, can you lead the TS patch?
Sam: Yep. I'll publish ts-sdk 2.1.1 with a compatibility check: on startup if we see encoded route generation enabled, print a one-line deprecation notice and opt-out via env `RD_ROUTE_LEGACY=false`.
Nina: Go team verified there's no change needed. But add an integration test in go-client to assert header equals `realid:...` for route-forwarding.
Sam: Also adding a small snippet in release notes showing how to decode the debug header: ````js
// when you see X-Rd-Parse: b64-json->realid:1234
const b = Buffer.from('eyJyZWFsbV9pZCI6IjEyMzQiLCJ2ZXIiOjF9', 'base64')
console.log(JSON.parse(b.toString()))
````
Rohit: Console/analytics: we'll need a one-off merge of the ephemeral buckets created between 02:00 and 09:45 UTC. Maya, can you output a CSV mapping of bad_key -> normalized_key? We'll hand to analytics to run the merge job.
Maya: On it. Exporting now and will drop in /tmp/rd-route-mapping-<date>.csv and ping analytics.
Sam: Rollout plan: 1) Keep permissive parse in canary for 6 hours; 2) ship ts-sdk 2.1.1 + py-sdk 1.5.1 with opt-out envs; 3) run mapping merge; 4) revert permissive parse; 5) watch telemetry.
Rohit: Add an alert: if `route.header.parse_strategy=b64-json` > 0.2% after final revert, fire pager.
Nina: Also add a console note in the migration docs so customers relying on experimental builds know why their route names changed.
infra-bot: canary rollout finished: edge-proxy v4.0.3-canary 1/1 healthy, 0 errors.
Maya: Thanks  assigning owners: Sam (TS + release notes), Rohit (telemetry rules + alert), Nina (analytics merge + console doc), Maya (canary monitor + mapping export). Will update thread after mapping job completes. :thumbsup:
